elements.label: Figure A26
elements.title: Revenue versus Advertising for a Fortune 500 Company ($000s) Showing Slope and y-Intercept Calculation in MS Excel
elements.summary: This table shows monthly advertising expenditure and corresponding revenue (both in thousands of dollars) for a Fortune 500 company. It also includes Excel formulas used to calculate the slope (61.8) and y-intercept (9,376.7) for the linear regression equation relating advertising spend to revenue.
